notes: Read all three units, full firearms context, all thirteen candidates and the review. Resolved the domestic-government and constitutional scope to the United States. Restored opposition to discrimination as the governing rationale and identity-related context for rejecting preferences, quotas and set-asides in education, corporate boards and contracting; identified the government as the U.S. government.

claims.claim_text: Opposition to any U.S. domestic government that is not bound by the U.S. Constitution or Bill of Rights.
Because of opposition to discrimination, rejection of identity-based preferences, quotas and set-asides in education and corporate boardrooms.
The U.S. government should not award contracts using identity-based preferences, quotas or set-asides.
Corporations should not award contracts using identity-based preferences, quotas or set-asides.
